rant quidem aliqua in deterius confuli,
non tamen ita gravi incommodo, ut non

Exitus aliquando docebit Subditos

liis, vel quæ pessimi omnium Confiliarii
mihi audebant proponere, vel in quæ
Ipse forsan propensior forem, obsequu-
tus fuissem, haud ita celeriter in Tribus
Regnis Florentissimis Ecclesiam pariter &
Rempublicam in illud Chaos confusionum
& ærumnarum Gehennam (quod nonnul-
lorum consiliis effectum est) conscii un-
quam potuisse: è quibus nec jam possunt,
vel certè nolunt quanquàm viribus ad id
satis pollentes, Me aut Subditos meos
redimere.
Nemo unquam libentiùs querelam in-
stituit, quàm ego cupidus eram corri-
gendi, quod Rationi meæ apparuit dictum
vel consultum perperam: quod quidem
me fecisse putabam, atque id paulò pro-
lixius quàm modesti homines exspecta-
bant-

page.notes: Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. The printed hyphen at "exspecta-" is kept; "bant," is the catchword that starts the next page. The page number is printed as "128" but the final digit is slightly unclear. Some printed accent marks (e.g. "libentiùs", "quanquàm") are copied as they appear. The small ornament after "redimere." is a printer's mark and is left out.
